ck: (2)petasancivini uktartan purvapaksanirasatina trtikartunarapyate –nanvityatina visnorprahnatvotkirtanan parErnayasapalasya kasyacitvisnvakyasyasnatataviva nikilaprapancatatatnyanankikaratkatan tatapiprayena purvapaksotitiriti sankanapakartun visnupataprahnapatayostrivitaparicetarahityarupavyaptivrtyartayo (vrtyartakayo) sananartatvena tayorekatvat tatupari purvapaksotitiriti pava utaratra cetanacetanapetayorvicarayisyananatvatasya visvapatartataya prasaktatvasucanaya cetanacetanatnakaniti visvavisesanan – isvarapratiyokikasyeti peta sanyokativatupayavrtistatatakapatarta pratiyokikastatanuyokikasca pavati inO sanyuktavayananena sanyuktoyanapyanena sanyukta iti pratitinanivenO pinavayanasnatpinoyan casnatpina iti pratitinanapatitanan satvat ekasyEva petasya katapratiyokikatvan tatanuyokikatvan cankikriyate kata svasnatpina ityatyapatisca svapratiyokikatvavisistapetatikaranatayastatrsapratitO niyanena pasananaya svasnin patitatvateva na prasacyate kata svena sanyukta iti pratityapativatiti natenetan ata evEtanatavastanpenEva cantre petanasritya tvO cantraviti pratitinupapatayisyantrstante satyavEkalyan pariharisyati tata cesvarapratiyokikatvena pratiyananasya cakat isvaratpinaniti pratitO pasananasyesvaro civatiprapancatpina iti pratitO pasananasya ca petasyEkatvenesvaratarnikatvenesvarapratyaksatvenapratyaksatvaneva katakakanasanyokavat sanpantapratyakse yavatasrayapratyaksasya karanatvatiti pava etena purvasloke cakatpratiyokikesvarapetasyEva prasaktatvena tatrEva vicarasya prakrantatvenesvarapratiyokikapetasyapratyaksatvavacananasankatan evan pratiyokyapratyaksatvasya petapratyaksatvasanpatakatve stanpa pisaco neti petasya pratyaksatvanupapatiriti parastan purvoktanate isvarapratiyokikasyapi petasyesvaratarnikatvankikarenaprasaktavicararupatvapavatetanate stanpa pisaco neti pratiteranunitisaptatirupatvapyupakanena pratyaksarupatvanapyupakanaca vasapta sanucaye yatva, peto yatpratiyokika natatvrti, kintvanuyokinatravrtiriti sarvasitinatenetan vakyan pravrtan tarhisvara pratiyokikapetasyapratyaksatvopapatanasya katanupayoka iti cetitan yata paskaranate kate nrta sahatyantapeto nrti tu katasyatyantapeta eva evan karyakaranayorpetapetO vyavastitO tata karaniputesvarasya cakata sahatyantapetepi cakatisvarenatyantapinaniti natanapakartun vipina ityuktan visesato vipinatvan ca svatyantapinacakatpratiyokikatyantapetavatvan itan ca purvaslokaprasaktan tatanusarena visvapinatvasankakrantasya pinatvanityasyapyayanevarta tata ca petatvayasyapi
